title: Packing and covering in infinite matroids
description: OpenAI's theorem (2026) that the infinite matroid packing/covering conjecture is false in ZFC; through density ideals, an ultrafilter with an ordinal rank, local bases defined by probes, and a self-dual uniform matroid placed along a double ray.

units.title: Infinite matroids and the packing/covering conjecture
Ideals, ultrafilters and an ordinal rank

prerequisites: core course Mathematical Logic, Set Theory, and Computability (C80): Button, Set Theory: An Open Introduction (Open Logic Project), Proposition 10.2, Theorem 11.4, Lemma 14.2, Corollary 14.10, Theorem 15.11, Proposition 15.12, Theorem 5.16, Theorem 16.6
